prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1340; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a distal radius fracture sustained when bracing a fall against the vehicle. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported event, and the presenting complaints were appropriate for this type of trauma. Radiographs and the physical examination clearly confirmed the fracture, with focal tenderness, swelling, and restricted wrist motion on the injured side. Closed reduction was performed and the wrist was immobilized in a cast, followed by a structured course of hand therapy. The patient attended 27 visits over the course of care, which ran somewhat longer than is typical for an uncomplicated fracture of this kind, largely due to stiffness and gradual progression of range-of-motion recovery. The chart notes a remote, minor strain involving the same region that resolved completely without lasting limitation and did not affect the current presentation. Billing records reviewed alongside the clinical notes show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services.
